name: Hamada Shinnosuke
source:
3rd Year High School Student. 
Representative of Shinagawa.
Hobby: Using Money
Special Skill: Butterfly (Swimming)
Favorite Food: Sharkfin/Chocolate
Hated Thing: Poorness/Vegetables (Especially Green Peppers and Carrots)
Confession Specialty: Poet who unleashes words in a good rhythm.
